lead: Personal communication and pocket devices — phones, tablets and e-readers, wearables, PDAs, navigators and trackers, two-way and amateur radio, and their power and accessories — organised by device type, with phone lines broken down into generations and collector icons as archetypes.

depts.note: Tier for everyday buyers; variety for collectors of classic and iconic handsets.

b.v: weight 18, input 16, battery 16, display 12, camera 8 (Notebookcheck weights)
b.w: Handling, battery and display count most in the tested smartphone rating.
Years of updates the maker promises, recorded with a date.
Tested run time counts, not the mAh figure.

b.v: DXOMARK sub-scores: exposure, colour, autofocus, texture, noise, night, zoom
b.w: Image quality as tested, not megapixels.
Water and dust rating, and drop-test standard.

b.v: boxed complete > working unboxed > untested > parts
b.w: Classic handsets are valued by working order, original box and accessories.

s.brief: Use GSMArena's organising axis: maker -> line -> generation. Archetypes are phone lines (iPhone, Galaxy S, Galaxy Note, Galaxy Z Flip/Fold, Pixel/Nexus, Xperia, OnePlus numbered series, Xiaomi numbered series, Huawei P/Mate, HTC One, Moto G, Fairphone); versions are generations (original first, landmark generations such as iPhone 2007, iPhone 4, Galaxy S II). Keyboard smartphones: BlackBerry (Bold, Curve, Q10, Passport), Palm Treo, Nokia Communicator/E-series, Motorola Q, Unihertz Titan. Foldables: Galaxy Z Flip/Fold, Motorola razr (2019 revival), Pixel Fold, Honor Magic V, Huawei Mate X. Dual-screen: Microsoft Surface Duo, LG dual-screen. Gaming: ROG Phone, Red Magic, Black Shark. Rugged: CAT, Ulefone, Doogee, Samsung XCover. Drop the flat SKU lists; keep only generations that attach to an archetype.

k.brief: Line -> generation archetypes; ordered Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy S, Google Pixel/Nexus, then others.
BlackBerry is the collector icon here; include Nokia 9000 Communicator lineage.

s.brief: Collector icons as archetypes with versions: Nokia 3310 (2000 original; 2017 HMD revival as a version), Nokia 8110 'banana', Nokia 6110/5110, Nokia 1100, Nokia N-Gage, Sony Ericsson W800i Walkman/K750i; Motorola StarTAC, Motorola RAZR V3, Motorola MicroTAC; Nokia 7110 and N95 sliders; Nokia 7370 / Motorola V70 swivels. New 'Early mobile phone' kind for brick and bag phones (Motorola DynaTAC 8000X, Nokia Mobira Cityman). New 'Luxury phone' kind for Vertu (Signature, Ascent, Constellation) and similar jewelled/precious-material handsets. Order by significance, not alphabet.

k.brief: StarTAC (1996) and RAZR V3 (2004) as lead archetypes.
Brick and bag phones of the 1980s–early 1990s; DynaTAC as originator.
Vertu as originator; precious-material editions of mainstream phones as a type.

s.brief: Landline: merge DECT repeater in as a type/accessory note; keep current market brands (Gigaset, Panasonic, BT, Philips) and add classic telephone archetypes collectors seek: Western Electric candlestick and Model 500, Ericsson Ericofon, GPO Trimphone, Bell Princess, GPO 746. Satellite phone: Iridium, Inmarsat IsatPhone, Thuraya, Globalstar — tier, ≤8 models.

k.brief: Types: corded, cordless DECT, DECT repeater. Classic designs as archetypes.

b.w: Display comes first for tablets.
Second for tablets.
Which pen and keyboard fit, by tablet range.
E-readers are chosen by store first (Kindle, Kobo, PocketBook).
E-paper panel generation sets contrast and colour.

s.brief: Archetypes = lines with generations: iPad (original 2010), iPad mini, iPad Air, iPad Pro; Galaxy Tab S; Amazon Fire; Xiaomi Pad. E-readers: Kindle (original 2007, Keyboard, Paperwhite, Voyage, Oasis, Colorsoft), Kobo (Clara, Libra, Sage, Forma), Barnes & Noble Nook, Sony Reader (PRS-500 first), PocketBook, Onyx Boox, Bookeen. Writing tablets: reMarkable, Supernote, Kindle Scribe, Kobo Elipsa, Sony DPT. Turn the long SKU lists into versions under these lines.

b.w: Which phone platform it pairs with comes first.
How many days it runs between charges.
Heart-rate and GPS accuracy as tested by independent reviewers (e.g. DC Rainmaker).

s.brief: Archetypes = lines with generations: Apple Watch (Series, SE, Ultra), Samsung Galaxy Watch, Pebble (collector icon), Google Pixel Watch, Fitbit Versa/Sense; GPS watches: Garmin Forerunner, fenix, Enduro, Coros, Suunto, Polar Vantage/Grit; bands: Fitbit Charge/Inspire, Xiaomi Smart Band, Garmin vivosmart; hybrids: Withings ScanWatch / Nokia Steel, Garmin vivomove; screenless: Whoop, Polar Loop, Amazfit Helio Strap. Remove the 'GPS sports watches included' clause from Smartwatch so it does not overlap Multisport GPS watch; move Garmin fenix/D2 models accordingly.

Smart ring: Oura (originator) with generations, Samsung Galaxy Ring, Ultrahuman, RingConn, Amazfit Helio. Smart glasses: Google Glass (collector icon, Explorer Edition), Snap Spectacles generations, Ray-Ban Meta / Meta Ray-Ban Display, XREAL, Viture, RayNeo, Even Realities. Enclosed headsets stay in Video Games (VR & XR).

depts.note: Collector variety for PDAs and organisers; tier for current translators.

s.brief: One collector shelf. PDA archetypes: Apple Newton MessagePad (originator, 1993; versions 100–2100, eMate as a related form), Palm Pilot / PalmPilot, Palm III, Palm V, Palm Tungsten/Zire, Handspring Visor, Psion Series 3 / 5 / 5mx / Revo / Series 7, Sharp Zaurus, Compaq/HP iPAQ (Pocket PC), Casio Cassiopeia, Sony Clié. Organiser archetypes: Psion Organiser (1984) and Organiser II, Sharp Wizard, Casio digital diary (SF series), Franklin/Rolodex organisers.
Restraint: market-covering brands only (Casio Ex-word, Sharp, Pocketalk, Vasco, Timekettle).

b.v: Apple Find My / Google Find Hub / own network
b.w: Item trackers depend on the size of the phone network that finds them.
Coverage and running cost decide satellite messengers.
How long it runs in the field.

s.brief: Tier: market-covering brands plus test winners. Handheld GPS needs a source and brands beyond Garmin (Magellan as historic, Bushnell, TwoNav). Car sat-nav: Garmin, TomTom. Item trackers: Apple AirTag, Samsung SmartTag, Tile, Chipolo, Pebblebee. Satellite messengers: Garmin inReach, SPOT, Zoleo, ACR Bivy, Motorola defy. PLB: ACR ResQLink, Ocean Signal rescueME. Satellite hotspot: Iridium GO!, Inmarsat IsatHub, Thuraya. Cut duplicated SKUs (e.g. five Tile variants) to one line each.

depts.note: Variety for amateur (ham) radio and scanners; tier for licence-free walkie-talkies; trade/public-safety radio stays kind-level only.

b.w: What you may transmit depends on the licence held.

b.v: HF / VHF / UHF; FM, SSB, CW, digital (DMR, D-STAR, C4FM)
b.w: Which bands and modes a rig covers sets what it can do.

b.v: Sherwood Engineering table / ARRL QST product reviews
b.w: Independent receiver test rankings used by amateurs.

s.brief: Makers: Yaesu, Icom, Kenwood, Elecraft, FlexRadio, Xiegu, Alinco, Baofeng, AnyTone, Collins and Drake (vintage). Archetypes: Icom IC-7300, IC-705, IC-7610; Yaesu FT-991A, FT-817/818 lineage, FT-DX10, FT-5DR; Kenwood TS-590, TS-890, TH-D74/D75; Elecraft KX3, K3/K4; Baofeng UV-5R; Collins S-Line and KWM-2 (vintage icons). Merge the old commercial base-station and vehicle-mounted radio kinds into the ham base and mobile transceiver kinds; drop MOTOTRBO/APX trade models. Morse keys: straight key, paddle, bug (Vibroplex original).

k.brief: Desktop/base station rigs; types SDR or superhet; the old commercial base-station kind merges here without its trade models.
Vehicle-mounted VHF/UHF or HF rigs for amateurs; commercial P25 models drop.
Low-power field rigs (FT-817 lineage, KX3, IC-705).
Types: dipole, vertical, Yagi beam, end-fed, magnetic loop.
Straight key, iambic paddle, semi-automatic bug; Vibroplex as originator of the bug.

s.brief: Walkie-talkie: licence-free consumer (Motorola Talkabout, Cobra, Midland) as types PMR446 / FRS / GMRS; remove trade MOTOTRBO models. New CB radio (Cobra 29 as icon, Uniden, President, Midland). New radio scanner (Uniden Bearcat, Whistler, Uniden BCD436HP). New SDR receiver (RTL-SDR dongle, SDRplay, Airspy). Pager: keep Motorola Minitor (volunteer-firefighter owned) and add consumer pager icons (Motorola Bravo) as archetypes.

b.v: Wh; under 100 Wh for air travel
b.w: Capacity comes first, stated in watt-hours.
Second.
Third.

s.brief: Fix the Anker-only skew: market-covering brands (Anker, Belkin, Ugreen, Baseus, INIU, Mophie, Apple, Samsung) plus independent test winners (Wirecutter, RTINGS, Which?). ≤10 models per kind; capacity/magnetic as types.
Restraint: merge tablet case and e-reader cover into one kind; keep brand ranges (OtterBox, Spigen, ZAGG, Apple, Samsung, Kobo) without SKU lists.
Restraint: one strap kind; styluses and keyboard covers by range.
Restraint: cut the gimbal list (17 models) to market-covering lines (DJI Osmo Mobile, Zhiyun Smooth, Hohem iSteady, Insta360 Flow).
